title: Cabinets in multi-party democracies 1989-1990
authors: Roozendaal, P.J.A.J. van, Rijksuniversiteit Groningen * Groningen, Fac. PPSW, Interuniversitair centrum theorievorming en methodenontwikkeling sociologie, ICS * Groningen (primary investigator)
descriptions: Composition and durability of cabinets in 14 West-European countries. Dominant parties and central parties / number of religious parties / power of central parties / cabinet heterogeneity / cabinet fractionalization / weight power excess / typology of parliaments / predictions concerning cabinet composition and durability of each parliament. Background variables: residence
